crm_notes: Company: mid-market SaaS (ITSM/productivity) — builds internal helpdesk chat + agent assistant for 700 employees.
Primary ask: low-latency streaming chat (internal agents and end-users), tool calling into ticketing system, tight audit trail + retention windows for compliance.
POC notes: integrated hosted API with their ticketing sandbox via function-calling. Tool calls worked; sequence length short, KV cache hit fairly high for common prompts.
Latency: baseline Hosted API streaming meets functional needs but 95p occasionally spikes ~250-300ms under synthetic peak. Product team wants guaranteed 95p <200ms for agent-facing flows.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit if Dedicated reduces unit cost and gives stable tail latencies. CFO wants ARR estimate + committed capacity tier before approval.
Security: must have SSO/SAML for console, audit logging exported to their SIEM, retention controls configurable per route, and KMS integration for keys. Data residency preference: NA region only.
Quote from CPO: 'We need responses indistinguishable from internal KB lookups — any visible lag hurts agent adoption.'
Current plan: finish latency tuning on Hosted POC (batching/prefetch, tokenization tweaks), then run a short Dedicated pilot or reserved capacity test against their peak hour traffic pattern.
Docs shared: pricing term sheet draft, SOC2 bundle, guide for VPC deployment. Security team asked for sample audit logs and retention APIs.
Open Jira: INF-4127 to track SDK patch for streaming reconnects; SEC-2289 for KMS integration questions.
